correctness.rationale: The exact three-sun has triangle on 0,1,2 and independent vertices 3,4,5 adjacent to pairs 01,12,02. In the ordinary rooted-forest Morse complex each oriented incidence is a vertex and a face is a partial directed forest without vertex/edge reuse or directed cycles. Independent full enumeration yields 18 simplicial vertices and 1444 nonempty faces, f=(18,123,394,585,324). The displayed order of 18 incidence indices generates 708 disjoint matched Hasse pairs; independent reconstruction of EVERY Hasse arrow (5388) and zero-indegree topological sort consumed all 1444 face vertices, giving global acyclicity. Exactly one 0-cell and 27 4-cells survive, with no attaching dimensions 1,2,3; each 4-cell necessarily attaches to the point and the integral homotopy is a wedge of 27 S4. Laplacian determinant −27 and mod-two ranks are independent checks, not substituted for the Forman collapse proof.
residual_risks: Only six-vertex 3-sun, no uniform classification of all k-suns or all chordal graphs.
No equivariant, shellability or persistent-homology theorem claimed.
